title: moderation.completed
description: The verdict for one moderation target. THIS EMIT IS THE ACTION ON THE TARGET: stapel-listings and stapel-reviews consume it and change the thing themselves — moderation never calls back into a host to mutate. Target-generic: {target_type, target_key} address the target; a consumer ignores verdicts for types that are not its own. Content, complaint text, complainant identity, model reasoning and evidence never ride this topic.

decision.description: approved — no violation; rejected — violation, take the target down; needs_review — the automation abstained (not terminal for the case); dismissed — the report needed no action, the target is untouched.

reason_code.description: Key of the emitter's open reason registry.

note.description: Statement of reasons, truncated to VERDICT_NOTE_WIRE_CHARS.

decided_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the verdict row.
